scope.claim_target: Transfer of explicitly taught analytical GPU concepts to unseen, assumption-specified workload scenarios
scope.current_model_status: Uncalibrated analytical teaching assumptions; not real CUDA execution or a silicon predictor

formal_primary_task_requirements.answer_key: Independent evidence and hardware-expert review, not only the game's output
formal_primary_task_requirements.claim_boundary: If improvement is confined to parameter-variation items, claim near transfer only. The public numerical draft is not a validated final inventory.

scope.assessment_construct_validity: The eight numerical micro-scenarios in the draft are illustrative near-transfer/procedural-application tasks, not a ready primary efficacy inventory. Formal primary scenarios require independently reviewed changes in representations and structural conditions, such as novel timing or memory-trace tables, with evidence-grounded keys beyond pure number substitutions. If such validation and evidence are unavailable, restrict claims to the near-transfer of the stated simplified formulas.
scope.future_pool_requirement: Add a concept only after an explicit model or validated lesson, independent answer-key review, and matched exposure in every relevant condition.

mandatory_before_randomized_study: Implement one shared linkage engine and freeze its model version, parameter definitions, assumptions, workload inputs, action semantics, and outputs for ALL A/B/C conditions.
B is the shared engine with an ordinary unlinked evidence presentation; it is not the untouched old game if C changes underlying computation.
A/B/C expose the same raw facts, available diagnostic interventions, worked-example content, and six optional diagnostic opportunities in the same bounded learning window.
B/C have identical narrative, choices, progression, consequences, artwork, rules, and economic assumptions; C changes inspectable bridge presentation and access only.
If bridge presentation also adds facts or instructional content, declare the treatment an information-plus-scaffolding bundle instead of an isolated interface effect.
Freeze independently reviewed assessment keys, parallel-form assignment, scoring rubric, exclusion rules, missingness plan, and analysis code before confirmatory data collection.
Obtain applicable institutional ethics review and participant consent before recruitment or research telemetry collection.

design.assignment: Between-person randomized A/B/C assignment, stratified by prespecified baseline GPU-concept knowledge bands

A.name: same-model interactive workbench
A.presentation: Neutral task framing, common engine, facts, inputs, interventions and feedback

B.name: narrative game with ordinary evidence
B.presentation: Same narrative game as C; raw assumptions and performance/economy evidence accessible in ordinary separate panels

C.name: same narrative game with inspectable counterfactual bridge
C.presentation: Optional decision-to-assumption-to-resource-to-consequence inspection and alternative comparisons, using the same underlying engine and facts as B

design.session_components: Consent 5 min; pretest 15-20; common introduction 5; learning 25; posttest 15-20; questionnaires 5-10. Optional interview time is additional.
design.primary_contrast_interpretation: Intention-to-treat effect of bridge availability within matched narrative and mechanics
design.contextual_contrast_interpretation: Whole presentation bundle comparison; does not separately identify narrative, agency, or game progression effects
controls: identical raw facts and formula reference
identical outcome tasks and questionnaire order
design.form_assignment: Counterbalance parallel forms across T0/T1/T2 and conditions; numbers and surface stories differ without changing target mechanisms.

timeline.notes: Stratification thresholds and analysis covariates fixed in advance; self-reported expertise does not replace objective baseline knowledge.
No think-aloud in the confirmatory experiment; it changes reasoning and is reserved for formative testing.
No simulator/web; common formula sheet; assessment timing and instructions identical across conditions.

timeline.when: after T1, same order in every condition
timeline.notes: Optional secondary questionnaires refer back to the learning activity. Placing them after the primary test avoids questionnaire priming of the primary outcome.

timeline.when: after Q1, optional additional activity of up to five real minutes
timeline.notes: Give every condition the same optional invitation; compensation does not depend on accepting or continuing. Record invitation receipt, acceptance, and real activity separately. This exposure is after T1 and recorded for interpretation of T2.
Use a new counterbalanced parallel form; record interim exposure to the game or external GPU learning.

metrics.instrument: Eight expert-reviewed illustrative scenario types, each with two objectively keyed items
metrics.scoring: Each item is scored 0 or 1, not necessarily a binary-choice question. An explicitly blank/skipped item is 0. A missing session is not a zero score.
metrics.baseline: Same construct using a different counterbalanced form at T0
metrics.limitations: Draft custom assessment, not a validated inventory or proof of real CUDA transfer.

metrics.instrument: Four prespecified explanation prompts, four rubric points each
metrics.blinding: Two independent raters blinded to condition and time; rubric frozen before study, agreement reported and disagreements adjudicated by a prespecified rule.
metrics.inferential_gate: Confirmatory test only after primary C-B transfer test passes the prespecified alpha=.05 gate.

metrics.notes: New parallel form, retention/continued-learning result interpreted with follow-up missingness and interim exposure.

metrics.instrument: Official IMI 22-item version: its seven interest/enjoyment items
metrics.formula: mean(seven item scores after official reverse scoring)
metrics.notes: Use one declared instrument version. Do not combine subscales into an invented engagement total.

metrics.construct: Perceived choice/voluntariness in the learning activity
metrics.instrument: Official IMI 22-item version: its five perceived-choice items
metrics.formula: mean(five item scores after official reverse scoring)
metrics.notes: This does not establish consequential narrative agency. Agency manipulation checks or a distinct agency experiment require separate operationalization.

metrics.instrument: Raw NASA-TLX, all six original dimensions
metrics.direction: lower workload, not automatically better learning
metrics.notes: Follow the instrument's performance anchors. RTLX is unweighted; do not label it the original weighted TLX or intrinsic/extraneous cognitive load.

metrics.inputs: p_i is probability that the intervention answer is correct, in [0,1]; y_i is its binary objective correctness
companion_reports: accuracy across the eight intervention items
metrics.notes: Collect confidence before feedback. Interpret jointly with accuracy; eight items give imprecise individual estimates, and Brier is not pure metacognitive ability. Missing probabilities are not silently imputed to zero.

metrics.construct: Incorrect generalization and possible negative learning
response_categories: explicitly uncertain or do not know
metrics.notes: Six independently reviewed boundary propositions with equivalent target concepts across forms. Uncertainty and missing responses are not wrong beliefs; report them separately. Report transitions as diagnostic evidence, not certain conceptual deterioration from one noisy response. Do not insert unmodeled networking or business truth into the hardware score.

metrics.valid_comparison: Baseline and intervention share workload and other modeled parameters; exactly one declared factor changes; both corresponding outcomes are exposed.
metrics.notes: Completion is not itself proof of causal understanding. Record opportunity exposure separately; do not reward arbitrary clicks or condition analyses on completion.

metrics.denominator: all randomized people assigned C, with missing telemetry explicitly identified
metrics.notes: Also report opened/exposed opportunities with their counts. Clicker versus non-clicker learning differences are self-selected associations, not causal treatment effects.

metrics.construct: Behavioral uptake of optional additional activity
metrics.denominator: People for whom invitation receipt is confirmed; report nonreceipt and missing invitation/response telemetry by condition
metrics.companion_measure: Real foreground activity time: sum monotonic intervals in which the optional activity is selected, visible, and not explicitly paused, capped at 300000 ms; confirmed declines are 0, unknown time remains missing.
metrics.notes: Same invitation and maximum five real minutes in each condition, with compensation unchanged. Foreground time and acceptance are engagement diagnostics, not proof of intrinsic motivation or learning. Distinguish this phase from the fixed 25-minute intervention.

metrics.construct: Reasoning about conjectural business and software-ecosystem choices
metrics.denominator: Eligible responses and observed counts reported separately
time: optional interview after T1 or T2
metrics.notes: No unique optimal ethical/commercial route is presumed. Profit, route selection, and endings remain gameplay outcomes.

analysis.estimand: Intention-to-treat C-B difference in person-level T1 transfer percentage points
analysis.primary_model: Prespecified ANCOVA of T1 transfer on condition, T0 score, and counterbalanced form; include only additional baseline covariates declared before data collection.
hierarchy: C-B causal_T1 key secondary, gated on primary rejection
C-A bundle comparison and other metrics are secondary/exploratory estimates with uncertainty
report: all group sample sizes and flow
all prespecified outcomes including null or adverse findings
analysis.repeated_items: Items and follow-up sessions are not independent participants; if item-level models are used, account for person and item dependence.
analysis.exclusions: Only prespecified ineligibility, duplicate participation, or absence of consent, with counts reported. Post-randomization interface/technical failures remain in the assigned-condition flow and intention-to-treat population; affected outcomes are marked missing and handled by the missingness/sensitivity plan. No exclusion merely for low uptake, rapid play, unfinished story, or unexpected scores.

missingness.explicit_skipped_assessment_item: Score 0 when the participant submitted the assessment and intentionally left/skipped the item.
missingness.missing_outcome_session_or_withdrawal: Mark missing, never score as zero or silently discard. Report counts/reasons by condition.
missingness.primary_plan_required: Prespecify model-based handling or multiple imputation under stated assumptions plus sensitivity analysis for differential attrition; distinguish it from a complete-case analysis.
missingness.questionnaires: Apply instrument rules; no ad hoc mean substitution. Declare minimum response completeness before recruitment.
missingness.telemetry: Missing events are unknown, not evidence of zero exposure or zero bridge use.

sample_size_planning.normal_approximation: n_per_group = 2 * (z_(1-alpha/2) + z_power)^2 / d^2; about 63, with a usual two-sample t calculation about 64 per group
sample_size_planning.practical_effect_example: Two of sixteen additional correct items = 12.5 percentage points; if the person-level SD were 25 points, d would equal .5. Neither SD nor a universal worthwhile threshold is established.
sample_size_planning.required_next_step: Choose the smallest worthwhile effect with the research goal and recruitment budget, then simulate the planned analysis across plausible variance, baseline correlation, item dependence, and missingness. Add recruitment allowance for expected missing outcomes.
sample_size_planning.pilot: Approximately 12-18 people can check feasibility, item difficulty, floor/ceiling and telemetry. A small pilot does not establish the efficacy effect or adequate confirmatory N.
sample_size_planning.budget_fallback: If a three-arm adequately powered study is infeasible, prioritize B/C; a small A arm is exploratory and not a proven strong-baseline comparison.

telemetry_schema_proposal.clock_rules: Use real monotonic deltas within a session for response durations. Real wall UTC supports ordering across sessions. Simulation time, idle progress and offline settlement must never be substituted for human engagement duration. A resumed session starts a new monotonic origin.
telemetry_schema_proposal.data_minimization: Collect only consented study fields. Separate contact information and identifiers from research events; free-text interview data require declared handling.

instrument_adaptation.chinese_status: No Chinese adaptation is automatically validated by translating an English instrument.
instrument_adaptation.required: Declare exact source versions and language. Use an appropriate existing validated translation if available; otherwise document translation/back-translation and cognitive debriefing, inspect reliability/structure where sample permits, and label adaptation limitations.
instrument_adaptation.avoid: Do not pile PXI, IMI, SUS, UEQ, flow and workload instruments into one confirmatory battery without distinct hypotheses.
